This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Only 1,354 Tiger I tanks were ever built—expensive, mechanically fragile, yet psychologically devastating. When operational, a single Tiger with an elite crew could devastate vastly superior forces. Tiger ace Michael Wittmann destroyed 14 tanks, 15 APCs, and 2 guns in under 15 minutes. The Tiger's legend far exceeded its actual battlefield effectiveness, cemented by Hollywood and Allied fear.
